The highest point in the United States is Denali (also known as Mount McKinley) in Alaska, with a summit elevation of 20,310 feet (6,190 m) above sea level [d6][d10][d2]. Denali is also the highest peak in all of North America and is located in south-central Alaska [d1][d10]. For those interested in the contiguous United States (excluding Alaska and Hawaii), the highest point is Mount Whitney in California's Sierra Nevada range, at approximately 14,494–14,505 feet above sea level [d2][d3][d8]. Other notable high points include Mount Elbert in Colorado at 14,440 feet, the highest peak in the Rocky Mountains [d8].
